_what: GenBank S81242.1 — 'EWS...CHN {junction region} [human, myxoid chondrosarcoma patient, mRNA Partial Mutant, 3 genes, 175 nt]' — RESOLVED to EWSR1 exon 7 :: NR4A3 exon 2, the type-2 junction, from its own nucleotides against this repository's committed transcript models.
_why: Two things at once. (1) The breakpoint census lists S81242.1 among 'deposits_whose_titles_name_an_EMC_FUSION' and marks the whole block '⛔ THEY ARE LISTED, NOT MAPPED'. It is now mapped. (2) This repository's own nuccore sweep RETRIEVED this record on 2026-08-15 and graded it INSERT with a 102-nt segment 'placed nowhere' (found_in: []). That grade is WRONG, and the reason it is wrong is a real defect worth keeping.
_cost: $0 — one eutils efetch on a free GitHub-hosted runner, then ungapped alignment against the committed emc-construct-inputs.json cache. No network from the sandbox, no GPU.

the_record.definition_verbatim: EWS...CHN {junction region} [human, myxoid chondrosarcoma patient, mRNA Partial Mutant, 3 genes, 175 nt]

paper.authors: Clark,J., Benjamin,H., Gill,S., Sidhar,S., Goodwin,G., Crew,J., Gusterson,B.A., Shipley,J. and Cooper,C.S.
paper.title: Fusion of the EWS gene to CHN, a member of the steroid/thyroid receptor gene superfamily, in a human myxoid chondrosarcoma

the_record.⚠_provenance_caveat_that_matters: REMARK on the record: 'GenBank staff at the National Library of Medicine created this entry [NCBI gibbsq 176286] from the original journal article.' This is a record TRANSCRIBED FROM PRINT, not an electronic submission by the authors. That is the mechanism behind the single-base discrepancy below, and it is evidence, not a guess — the sibling record S81243.1 carries the identical REMARK.

⭐_the_derivation._method: Ungapped alignment of the deposit's own nucleotides against the committed spliced transcript models (junction_aso.transcript_model, TRANSCRIPT_SOURCE=cache; PROVENANCE_GATE_USED reported 'graded_exon_audit' for both EWSR1 and NR4A3). The depositor's gene annotations were NOT consulted while deriving, and are used below only as an independent check.

donor_side.result: an EXACT substring of spliced EWSR1 (ENST00000397938), ending at transcript nt 862
donor_side.placement: 862 == the cumulative 3' END of EWSR1 transcript exon 7. EXACT BOUNDARY.

acceptor_side.result: aligns to NR4A3 (ENST00000395097) transcript exon 2 from its 5' START (transcript nt 523)
acceptor_side.placement: EXACT BOUNDARY — the 5' start of NR4A3 transcript exon 2
acceptor_side.the_single_mismatch: deposit nt 142 = A; NR4A3 transcript nt 624 = G. One base, in a record typed from print.
acceptor_side.⛔_this_is_reported_not_corrected: The discrepancy is recorded as measured. It is NOT patched, and no design is derived from the deposit's base at that position — the seam itself is 121 nt away from it and is identical in both.

⭐_the_derivation.⭐_independent_agreement: The depositor's own annotation splits the record at exactly the same point — gene 1..40 = EWS, gene 41..175 = CHN — and was not used to derive it. Same double-confirmation pattern the repository applied to AF524261.1.

⛔_it_corrects_a_grade_this_repository_al.the_wrong_grade: nr4a3-deposited-junctions.json / the 2026-08-15 nuccore sweep graded S81242.1 as INSERT with '+102 nt' and found_in: [] — a segment 'placed nowhere'. The sweep's own note groups it with DI174531.1 and LG067228.1 as records whose signature is a disagreement between the seam matcher and the maximal alignment.
⛔_it_corrects_a_grade_this_repository_al.why_it_happened: nr4a3_nuccore_sweep aligns by EXACT SUBSTRING (_longest_prefix_in / _shortest_suffix_start_in binary-search on `in`). A single base difference anywhere in the acceptor block truncates the matchable suffix to whatever follows the mismatch — here 33 nt — and everything 5' of it becomes an 'unexplained segment'. The +102 is exactly the offset of the mismatch, not a biological insert.
⛔_it_corrects_a_grade_this_repository_al.⚠_the_failure_shape: AN EXACT-MATCH ALIGNER CANNOT DISTINGUISH A NOVEL SEGMENT FROM A ONE-BASE DISCREPANCY, and it reports both as 'placed nowhere'. That is an absent reading wearing the costume of a finding — the same class as the census's own '⛔_the_transferable_lesson'. Reproduced here by the same arithmetic plus one mismatch-tolerant pass.
⛔_it_corrects_a_grade_this_repository_al.what_would_fix_it: give the placement step a small mismatch budget (>=1 per 100 nt) and REPORT the mismatches, rather than requiring exact containment. The other two records (DI174531.1 +1018 nt, LG067228.1 +1027 nt) are patent accessions with far larger segments and are NOT re-graded here — nothing about this finding speaks to them, and they must be re-tested rather than assumed.
⛔_it_corrects_a_grade_this_repository_al.⛔_not_done_here: The fix is NOT applied and nr4a3-deposited-junctions.json is NOT edited. That artifact is a published record of a sweep; changing it needs the sweep re-run, not a hand edit.

what_it_does_and_does_not_change.junction_confirmed: EWSR1_e7__NR4A3_e2 gains a FOURTH independent source, and it is the EARLIEST and the only one that is a patient's actual sequence rather than prose. The census currently lists three: PMID 22567356 (a review), PMID 29937513 (one of five sequenced cases), PMID 35488288 (a case report). This adds PMID 8570200 / GenBank S81242.1, 1996.
what_it_does_and_does_not_change.⭐_the_modelled_seam_is_now_confirmed_aga: nr4a3-fusion-junction-atlas-noncoding-acceptor.json models this seam as ACGGGCAGCAGA|AGCCCACTGCGG. The deposit reads ...AGCTACGGGCAGCAGA|AGCCCACTGCGGAAGA... — BYTE-IDENTICAL across the seam. The five designs at this junction were built on a modelled chimera; that model now has a 1996 patient sequence behind it.
what_it_does_and_does_not_change.⛔_NO_COVERAGE_NUMBER_MOVES: k=1/20 for this junction is a count from the two pooled series, and a fourth report with no cohort denominator cannot change it — the same rule the census applies to TCF12's 1/1. 82.9% best-supported buildable and the 98.3% ceiling are unchanged. One home for the arithmetic: fusion-junction-aso-coverage-ladder.json.
what_it_does_and_does_not_change.does_not_resolve_the_three_unnamed_tumou: S81242.1 is a different report by a different group with no patient identifier linking it to PMID 12378528's series. It says nothing about the three unresolved EWSR1 tumours.

screened_design_already_on_disk_at_this_._note: The task asked whether a screened design already exists at any recovered junction. It does — this junction is NOT in the manuscript's 38-junction panel (every one of those uses NR4A3 exon 3; aso-per-junction-table.json contains no NR4A3 exon-2 acceptor at all), but it IS carried by the non-coding-acceptor lane and has been through all five deep screens.

best_by_gap_specificity_margin.screens_run_verbatim: ran: exhaustive_transcript_scan, genome_grch38, mature_parent_gap_pairing, premrna, transcriptome_blast_deep; NOT run: none

screened_design_already_on_disk_at_this_.⚠_what_this_is_not: Not an efficacy claim and not a clinical claim. A screened design is sequence arithmetic plus off-target scans; nothing here has been synthesised or tested, and no statement about potency, delivery, tolerability or a therapeutic window is made or implied. One home for the per-design counts: research/modalities/noncoding-acceptor/aso-noncoding-acceptor-screened-table.json.
